description: Expected output of examples/celegans_workflow.py --headless (GT-derived boxes only, no interactive edits). Checked by tests/test_real_data_workflow.py.
axis_convention: Arrays as returned by tifffile.imread, shape (140, 140, 1244), used as napari (z, y, x). Per-slice COCO/YOLO slices along axis 0; COCO image height 140, width 1244.

yolo.sha256_recipe: for each file name in sorted order: update(name.encode() + b'\0' + text.encode() + b'\0')

provenance.source: a dry run of the README workflow, recorded in the verification records kept by the authors (a4_dryrun_report.json, key celegans, with the files coco_per_slice.json and yolo/ next to it; napari 0.7.0, napari_turbobox at commit 1b2ba33 of the private development repository; the code of src/napari_turbobox/export.py is unchanged since; only its docstrings were revised).
provenance.box_derivation: The dry run derived boxes with compute_bboxes from an earlier screenshot script (paper_benchmarks/generate_gui_screenshots.py, removed from the tree; a copy is in paper_results/provenance/benchmarked_code_state_20260925.tgz) (per-label argwhere min/max, ascending label order) and added them to a 4-viewer layout via create_synchronized_bbox_layers + add_boxes. examples/labels_to_boxes.py uses scipy.ndimage.find_objects (min = start, max = stop - 1, ascending label order). Both give the same boxes for this volume: the dry run recorded 0 boxes with an extent below 1 and all boxes inside [0, shape - 1], so the widening/clamping step changes nothing.
provenance.gui_check_is_not_this_fixture: A GUI check kept by the authors (gui_check.json) reports 555 boxes (554 GT-derived + 1 drawn), 140 COCO images, 7,391 annotations and 140 YOLO files for the same volume and the same axis convention. That export was taken after interactive edits: one GT box spanning z 63-73 (11 slices) was deleted with napari's Delete and one box was drawn with Add Rectangle and extruded over the full z range 0-139 (visible in its export_boxes.npy). 7,262 - 11 + 140 = 7,391 annotations; the drawn box adds the 76 slices without nuclei, so 64 + 76 = 140 images.
